name: ACA 331 有毒烟雾 有乘客昏迷

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air Canada 331, from Wuhan to Vancouver, push back and start up have been completed, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air Canada 331，从 Wuhan 到 Vancouver，推出和开车已完成，准备滑行，联系武汉地面请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, taxi to holding point runway 18R via taxiway Alpha 7, Alpha, Zulu 4 and Charlie.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，经滑行道 Alpha 7、Alpha、Zulu 4 和 Charlie 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18R via taxiway A7, A, Z4 and C, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A7、A、Z4 和 C 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点，ACA331。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, follow Airbus 319 on Mike to holding point runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，跟随 Mike 上的 Airbus 319 到跑道 18R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Follow A319 on M to holding point runway 18R, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随 M 上的 A319 到跑道 18R 等待点，ACA331。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, runway 18R is closed due to disabled aircraft on the runway, change your ATC clearance to runway 18L, Zulu Foxtrot 12 departure, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，跑道 18R 因跑道上有故障航空器关闭，将你的 ATC 许可改为跑道 18L，Zulu Foxtrot 12 离场，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: Roger, runway 18L, ZF12 departure, the rest unchanged, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 18L，ZF12 离场，其余不变，ACA331。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, enter runway 18R from Charlie 3, vacate runway via Charlie 4, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，从 Charlie 3 进入跑道 18R，经 Charlie 4 脱离跑道，报告脱离。
cards.referenceText: Enter runway 18R from C3, vacate runway via C4, report vacated, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从 C3 进入跑道 18R，经 C4 脱离跑道，报告脱离，ACA331。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have exited the runway 18R via Charlie 4, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已通过 Charlie 4 脱离跑道 18R，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA331, runway 18R vacated via C4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA331，已通过 C4 脱离跑道 18R。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, continue taxi to holding point 18 left via taxiway Mike, Alpha and Alpha 1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，继续经滑行道 Mike、Alpha 和 Alpha 1 滑行至 18L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi to holding point 18L via taxiway M, A and A1, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续经滑行道 M、A 和 A1 滑行至 18L 等待点，ACA331。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, climbing to 1800 meters, you see a helicopter ten o'clock above, it is closing to your aircraft, inform Wuhan Departure and request right turn to avoid the traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已离地，爬升到 1800 米，看到一架直升机在 10 点钟方向上方，正接近你的飞机，通知 Wuhan Departure 并请求右转避让该交通。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA331, airborne, climbing to 1800 meters, we see a helicopter 10 o'clock above, closing, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA331，已离地，爬升到 1800 米，我们看到一架直升机在 10 点钟方向上方，正在接近，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2400 meters, maintain visual separation with the helicopter.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，右转航向 240，加快爬升到 2400 米，与直升机保持目视间隔。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2400 meters, maintain visual separation with the helicopter, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，加快爬升到 2400 米，与直升机保持目视间隔，ACA331。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, after traffic is clear, track direct to Zulu Foxtrot, resume own navigation, climb and maintain 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，交通解除后，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，恢复自主导航，爬升并保持 5100 米。
cards.referenceText: After traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb and maintain 5100 meters, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 交通解除后，直飞 ZF，恢复自主导航，爬升并保持 5100 米，ACA331。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9500 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 5655, contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你保持 9500 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 5655，联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, maintaining 9500 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA331，保持 9500 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 5655。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, climb and maintain 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，郑州管制，雷达识别，爬升并保持 10100 米。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, your cabin crew report there are toxic fumes in rear cabin, you decided to expedite descent for smoke removal, make a Distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 突然，客舱乘务员报告后客舱有有毒烟雾，你决定为排烟加快下降，向郑州管制发出遇险呼叫并请求在 3000 米改平。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, the cabin crew report there are toxic fumes in rear cabin, request expedite descent to 3000 meters for smoke removal.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，郑州管制，ACA331，客舱乘务员报告后客舱有有毒烟雾，请求加快下降到 3000 米以排烟。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1008, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 030，按 QNH 1008 下降到 3000 米，可以时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1008, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 030，按 QNH 1008 下降到 3000 米，ACA331。

cards.audioText: B: After cabin check, tell Zhengzhou Control the toxic fume might be caused by dangerous goods leaking in the cargo hold.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 客舱检查后，告诉 郑州管制，有毒烟雾可能由货舱危险品泄漏引起。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, the toxic fume might be caused by dangerous goods leaking in the cargo hold.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA331，有毒烟雾可能由货舱危险品泄漏引起。

cards.audioText: B: Several passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume and become unconscious, tell Zhengzhou Control the situation and request diversion to Zhengzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 数名旅客受到有毒烟雾严重影响并失去意识，向郑州管制说明情况并请求改航 Zhengzhou。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, several passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume and become unconscious, request divert to Zhengzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA331，数名旅客受到有毒烟雾严重影响并失去意识，请求改航 Zhengzhou。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, Zhengzhou Control, roger, turn left heading 360, contact Zhengzhou Approach 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，郑州管制，收到，左转航向 360，联系郑州进近120.35。

cards.audioText: C: Air Canada 331, Zhengzhou Approach, radar contact, track direct to Charlie Golf Oscar, descend to 3000 meters, expect radar vector ILS runway 12.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air Canada 331，郑州进近，雷达识别，直飞 Charlie Golf Oscar，下降到 3000 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 12。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to CGO, descend to 3000 meters, expect radar vector ILS runway 12, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 CGO，下降到 3000 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 12，ACA331。

cards.audioText:
C: Air Canada 331, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell Zhengzhou Approach you need an ambulance and dangerous goods specialists.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air Canada 331，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉 郑州进近 你需要救护车和危险品专家。
cards.referenceText: Request an ambulance and dangerous goods specialists, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求救护车和危险品专家，ACA331。
